partner_result.applied_scope: weighted local Edgeworth/coarea expansion for fixed exact three-bank uniform witnesses

new_result.statement: For B_u=I-2uu^T and three independent centered-uniform banks, p_Qm(0)=3sqrt(2)[1-c(u)/m+O_u(m^-2)] with c(u)=(177-39 sum u_j^4)/640=69/320+(39/1280)sum_{i<j}B_ij^2. Hence 69/320<=c<=41/160. Fully coupled exact rational orientations can approach 69/320 arbitrarily closely.
new_result.target_implication: Qualitative nonzero rotation/coupling cannot give a uniform strict first-order density gap below the 3sqrt(2) obstruction; any such proof split must quantify coupling.
new_result.continuity: proved only for the witness bank family with m>=3; full-target continuity open

unresolved_implication: Can fragmented/nonuniform cap-one bank laws reverse the sign of the local correction or produce a witness above 3sqrt(2), while retaining exact product provenance?
next_step: Change witness mechanism from centered uniform Edgeworth banks to fragmented/nonuniform cap-one bank laws, or prove a product-preserving local-limit inequality forcing approach from below in that broader class.
